literature_notes: All three ledger lines describe C-terminal constructs. L1 and L2 report 'GPRC5B-HA', a standard gene-name-tag naming convention universally indicating a C-terminal HA tag. L3 reports 'GPRC5B-RLuc' and 'GPRC5B-YFP', again C-terminal fusions used in a BRET homo-oligomerization assay. The GPRC5B C-terminus (residue 403, W) lies within IC4 (residues 293–403), which is the long intracellular C-tail following TM7 (272–292). All three tags are therefore on the cytoplasmic face and do not qualify as extracellular surface tag sites. No ledger line names a residue, loop, or junction on the extracellular face of GPRC5B, nor does any line describe an N-terminal tag (which would be written 'HA-GPRC5B'), an internal insertion, or a tag in any of the four extracellular loops/domains (EC1 29–56, EC2 114–126, EC3 183–199, EC4 254–271). The mature N-terminus begins at residue 29 (E) after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 28 (S), and EC1 is 28 residues long — a plausible surface site topologically — but no ledger line supports a tag there. Zero qualifying extracellular sites.

literature_other_positions.note: GPRC5B-HA C-terminal HA tag expressed in Flp-In T-REx HEK293 cells; residue 403 (W) is in IC4 (293–403), the cytoplasmic C-tail after TM7.
GPRC5B-RLuc and GPRC5B-YFP C-terminal fusions used in BRET assay; both fusions are at the intracellular C-terminus (residue 403, IC4 293–403).
